${scope.a} : ${scope.b} : ${scope.c}
$$

structures.questionTemplate:
In a hawker centre, the ratio of the number of tables to the number of benches is ${scope.ratio_a} : ${scope.ratio_b}.

There are ${scope.a_count} tables in the hawker centre. How many benches are there?
steps: Set up the proportion corresponding to ${scope.ratio_a} unit(s) = ${scope.a_count} tables.

Calculate the value of 1 unit:

$$1 \text{ unit} = ${scope.a_count} \div ${scope.ratio_a} = ${scope.multiplier}$$

Find the total number of benches (${scope.ratio_b} units):

$$${scope.ratio_b} \times ${scope.multiplier} = ${scope.ans}$$

structures.questionTemplate:
A floor mosaic has yellow, white, and grey tiles in the ratio ${scope.r1} : ${scope.r2} : ${scope.r3}.

There are ${scope.yellow} yellow tiles on the floor altogether. How many white tiles and grey tiles are there respectively?

(Enter answers separated by a comma, e.g., 840, 1260)
steps:
Find the value of 1 unit:

$$1 \text{ unit} = ${scope.yellow} \div ${scope.r1} = ${scope.mult}$$

Calculate white tiles (${scope.r2} units) and grey tiles (${scope.r3} units):

$$\text{White} = ${scope.r2} \times ${scope.mult} = ${scope.white}$$
$$\text{Grey} = ${scope.r3} \times ${scope.mult} = ${scope.grey}$$
The number of white and grey tiles are ${scope.white} and ${scope.grey} respectively.
